title: 2 Chronicles 11
paragraphs: ¹ When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered the house of Judah and Benjamin — a hundred and eighty thousand fighting men — to wage war against Israel and reclaim the kingdom for himself. ² But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God: ³ "Speak to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and to all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin. ⁴ Tell them: 'This is what the LORD says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers. Let every man go home, for this is my doing.'" They obeyed the words of the LORD and turned back from marching against Jeroboam. ⁵ Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built up cities for defense throughout Judah.

⁶ He built up Bethlehem, Etam, and Tekoa, ⁷ and Bethzur, Soco, and Adullam, ⁸ and Gath, Mareshah, and Ziph, ⁹ and Adoraim, Lachish, and Azekah, ¹⁰ and Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron — all fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.

¹¹ He strengthened their defenses, installed commanders in them, and stocked them with food, olive oil, and wine. ¹² He equipped every city with shields and spears and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin remained his. ¹³ The priests and Levites from all across Israel rallied to him from all their territories,

¹⁶ and after them came all those from every tribe of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the LORD God of Israel. They came to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the LORD, the God of their ancestors. ¹⁷ They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and kept Rehoboam son of Solomon strong for three years, because they walked in the way of David and Solomon for those three years.

²¹ Rehoboam loved Maachah daughter of Absalom more than any of his other wives and concubines — he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and was the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters. ²² He appointed Abijah son of Maachah as the chief, to be the leader among his brothers, because he intended to make him king. ²³ He acted wisely, distributing his sons throughout all the territories of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city, and gave them generous provisions. He also acquired many wives for them.
